title: TeleBezel settings
address_hint: Hostname or IP address with port
ssl_hint: Disable only for a trusted local deployment
token_hint: Stored on the phone and never sent to the watch
default_account_hint: Opened right away when the watch app starts
default_account_unavailable: Accounts could not be loaded. Check the address and token, save, and reopen the settings to choose the default account.
show_archive_hint: When off, the watch shows only the main chat list
unread_mode_hint: Counts only chats with sound on, for the open list
